services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: September fishing in Crystal River is when the Nature Coast starts shifting from summer heat toward the first hints of fall, and one fish deserves most of the spotlight: gag grouper. The shallow rocks, ledges, holes, springs, and hard bottom off Crystal River create one of Florida’s most exciting shallow water grouper fisheries, and September brings a short, important harvest window under current 2026 Gulf regulations. For anglers who have been waiting on Crystal River grouper fishing charters, September is not a casual “maybe we’ll try it” month. It is a plan-around-the-calendar month. blurb: Florida Fishing Adventures offers fishing charters in the Crystal River and Homosassa areas, known as the Nature Coast of Florida. Guests fish in clear waters with habitats including islands, backcountry coves, and creeks for species like redfish, speckled trout, grouper, tarpon, and more. They also offer scalloping trips and all-inclusive fishing vacation packages.

quotes.author: Midge B
quotes.text: Successful scalloping. We took two boats out scalloping with 3 energetic, young boys. We had a fantastic time. Captain Louie and first mate, Braden and Captain Zach were fantastic. Braden got in with the boys and showed them what to do. Boats were spacious with everything we needed for a successful scalloping trip. We left with our bounty cleaned, shucked and ice; ready for our delicious dinner.

quotes.author: Marlene B
quotes.text: Our experience with Sean We took my great granddaughter who is sixteen to snorkel for bay scallops. She quickly learned how to find them with Sean’s guidance. We moved on to catching red fish. Caught our limit however had to release one that was too big. Wonderful experience and will go again when family comes.

quotes.author: Megan S
quotes.text: Best time on the water!! Had an amazing time with Captain Sean fishing for grouper! We had a great time on the water and caught some keepers to feed our friends and family! Crystal River is beautiful and peaceful too! Can't wait to come back next year!

quotes.author: Mike S
quotes.text: Scalloping fun! We went scalloping and had a wonderful time. Sean was on time, patient (hard to find the little beasts), and very friendly. Wife and I thoroughly enjoyed both the snorkeling and the scalloping. Top notch.

quotes.author: Marlene B
quotes.text: Outstanding We went with Tyler, who we have gone with several other times. He was excellent we caught lots of fish. Had a great time. Wouldrecommend them to anyone that wants to go fishing from shrimp’s Landing.

quotes.author: Bleecker S
quotes.text: Great girls trip Both the captain and his mate were attentive to our needs and great about helping us learn to scallop .. it was such a cool experience and we’re already talking about going back next year

quotes.author: Janice B
quotes.text: Fishing the flats of Crystal River We had a great time fishing with Captain Louie and his first mate Brayden(sorry if I misspelled). They put us on some nice fish and took care of our every need. Fun!

quotes.author: Cancuncaptain
quotes.text: Perfect Day of Fishing at Crystal River Great time fishing with Fla Fishing Adventures. Got our limit of Redfish and then began reeling in the sea trout. Weather and the seas cooperated greatly.
